'''Operation Nighthook''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Alliance organized three [[drop point]]s to support the operation; [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]], [[Drop Point: Condor]], and [[Drop Point: Laertos]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
